name: Improvement Pill
what_it_is: Self-improvement animation channel with social-skill series (e.g., BTGame social skills course) and habit-building content.
notes: Seed. Has 'Tamed Course'/social skills video series with assignments.

name: Matthew Hussey — Get The Guy / Love Life Club
what_it_is: Top dating coach for women: programs, monthly membership coaching, scripts and challenges, plus live retreats.
notes: Female-audience counterweight to male-PUA seeds; uses word-for-word scripts.

name: Hayley Quinn
what_it_is: UK dating coach for men and women; 6-week Men's Masterclass and women's group programs; real-world meeting skills.

name: Introverted Alpha (Sarah Jones)
what_it_is: Dating coaching company for introverted men emphasizing authentic strengths over pickup lines.
notes: Persona match: introverted men; free 22-page ebook outlines method.

name: Logan Murray — Comedy Course (UK)
what_it_is: London stand-up courses by 'Be a Great Stand-up' author; exercise-led teaching style.
notes: Book has many generative writing games (e.g., 'rant' exercises).
